purpose: Transparent multi-factor ranking of constraint-eligible alternatives using inspectable dimensions, weights, confidence, assumptions and sensitivity scenarios.
rules: Hard-constraint-ineligible options are excluded from winner ranking but retained in excluded_alternatives.
Every score contribution is inspectable by dimension.
Objective weights and dimension overrides are explicit inputs.
Prediction confidence can reduce evidentiary confidence but cannot create authority.
Sensitivity scenarios disclose whether modest changes alter the leader/order.
Ranking is advisory and grants no execution, permission, entitlement or approval authority.
